Passive.description: Cumulative distance traveled by the vehicle, captured continuously without active polling.

Active.description: Emergency event signal broadcast immediately upon crash sensor activation.

Dynamic.description: Highly volatile real-time telemetry representing engine revs and current vehicle speed.

Location.description: Global navigation satellite data indicating accurate direction heading and speed vectors.

Equipment.description: Unique alpha-numeric vehicle identification number hardcoded into the engine control unit.

Status.description: The active transmission gear selection state (Park, Reverse, Neutral, Drive).

User.description: Biometric or custom seat configuration profile indicating which suspect/user was driving.

Operational.description: Remaining physical fuel levels or high-voltage electric vehicle State of Charge (SoC).

Service.description: Active GPS application service telemetry mapping out the programmed route and final destination.

RFID.description: Cryptographic RFID identifier transmitted by the physical key fob to authorize engine ignition.

Historical.description: Historical diagnostic trouble codes stored in memory indicating past mechanical/electronic sensor faults.

Spectrum.description: Active telecommunication frequency band and provider metrics used for emergency eCall connectivity.

Environmental.description: External atmospheric temperature reading taken by the front bumper sensor array.
